$description: Shokunin Crafthouse · Primitives · raw token values · single source of truth. Generated from Figma Primitives collection (VariableCollectionId:2013:2). Anchors marked in token descriptions are the values extracted directly from stages/02-design/design-system-preview.html; non-anchored values are derived (palette interpolation, alpha steps, etc.) and called out per-token.

$metadata.spacingBase: Hybrid 4/8pt layout ladder + 2pt micro ladder. Layout: 4·8·12·16·20·24·28·32·48·64·80·96·120 px. Micro (chrome only): 2·6·10·14·18·22 px. Arbitrary px outside these ladders is a bug.
$metadata.fontStrategy: scds-v2: THREE families. Display = Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro (headings + section/subheads; weights 250/300/400/500/700/900 self-hosted; 95 Black/900 carries the headline register — thin→Black retires thin headers). Text = Neue Haas Grotesk Text Pro (body + chrome labels; 400/500/700). Mono = Cascadia Mono (Google Fonts CDN) — reduced to ~10% of surfaces: hex values / token names / code ONLY, dropped from chrome labels. family.sans kept as a back-compat alias. Heading weights: card title 24=bold(700), section title 32 + display 44/60/84/120 = black(900); body stays Text Regular(400); chrome labels Text Medium(500); weight 600 carries mono token-references + the secondary-button hover bump. Per-step composition tokens at font.text.{step} bind size + weight + lineHeight + tracking + family; surfaces reach for those. line-height + tracking kept canonical across the weight change. Full rationale in _config/design-system/type-system.md (re-sync pending). Mono re-affirmed Sprint 2 (Cascadia / Geist / JetBrains / IBM Plex) — see decisions/decisions.md.

dark.$description: Dark-mode ground ladder · SLATE since 2026-09-24 (replaces the scds-v2 true-neutral ladder). Every ground step holds OKLCH hue 252.3° and chroma 0.015, anchored on surfacePage #2C3239, measured off the sc-site Figma comp (file oIeQl6SlqWjvyZ126f65tn, Frame 19, node-id 156-15: the light comp under a #E3DFD8 exclusion blend). Text tiers are warm-light (hue 84.6°), as the blend produced. Luminance order is kept from the light ladder's roles, not inverted: well is darkest, raised5 is lightest. Elevation model (Phase 2): component sinks BELOW page (well), hover rises to page level. The P3 wide-gamut drift caveat for very dark values (studio learning #11) does not apply at these lightnesses (darkest step OKLCH L 0.262). See decisions.md 2026-09-24.

medium.$description: Medium · 500. UI labels, button text, section titles, eyebrows.

black.$description: Black · 900. NHG Display 95 Black. scds-v2 headline + section register (thin→Black, retires thin headers). @font-face added in src/styles/fonts.css.

flat.$description: Flat · 1.0. Display specimens at 120px, vertical alignment.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed · 1.55. Long-read prose, captions in cards.

loose.$description: Loose · 2.0. Widest leading step. 2026-08-16 Figma variable sync — present in the SCDS Primitives collection (font/lineHeight/loose), absent from code. Added for parity; no composition token binds it yet.

slight.$description: Slight · 0.02em. Button labels at 12 and 14px (Levi, sc-tune 2026-10-07; matches the library's 2% label tracking).

wider.$description: Wider · 0.06em. Mono caps at 11px in chrome.

caps.$description: Caps · 0.1em. Premium small caps treatment for sub-sections.

text.$description: Composed typography tokens · one per scale step. Resolves family + size + weight + lineHeight + tracking for the default register at that step. Surfaces SHOULD reach for these instead of the underlying primitives unless a single axis is deliberately overridden (e.g. set 32px in mono — override family, keep the rest). Full weight + optical rationale lives in _config/design-system/type-system.md. Sprint 2 deliverable resolving 2a.

11.$description: Chrome eyebrows, badges, button labels. Medium-weight optical compensation for NHG sub-pixel rendering at 11px; widest tracking sets chrome rhythm.

12.$description: UI labels, dense table headers. Same chrome-tier compensation as step 11; wide tracking (less than widest) because 12px holds rhythm with less air.

13.$description: Captions, muted secondary copy. Transitions out of chrome register into body register; regular weight + relaxed leading for reading-length captions.

14.$description: Secondary body, dense table cells, form helper text.

16.$description: Body default. Anchor of the weight rhythm — every other step calibrates against 16/400/1.5/0.

20.$description: Lead paragraph, intro body, large body. Regular preserves reading-text register one step above body.

24.$description: Card titles, mid-headlines. First step into headline register.

32.$description: Section titles, page headers. Section-marker weight; tight tracking separates from prose mass.

44.$description: Premise statements, hero subhead. Crosses into display register — NHG Light carries open counters; tighter tracking closes the rhythm so light doesn't read loose.

84.$description: Large display, hero primary. At this size, regular reads as bold — light is the considered weight.

120.$description: Maximum display, hero monumental. Flat 1.0 line-height for vertical alignment in two-line displays.

medium.$description: Medium text-face compositions beside the regular scale steps. Added 2026-10-05 for the Studio PM shell (the tab label).

12.$description: UI label, medium: 12/medium, no tracking (Figma text/label/ui-medium). Sidebar mode row. 2026-10-07 (ADR brand-site-sidebar-redesign).

13.$description: Tab label: 13/medium, no tracking (Figma text/label/tab). Studio PM segment tabs, 2026-10-05.

button.$description: Button label compositions: medium, loose 2.0 leading, slight tracking. The leading sets the key's height (14 × 2 + 2 × 8 + 2px border = 46px large, 12 × 2 + 2 × 4 + 2px border = 34px small). Levi, sc-tune record output/tuning/Button/2026-10-07-1418.

bold.$description: Bold text-face compositions beside the regular scale steps. Matched to the SCDS Figma library text style of the same role, 2026-10-03.

large.$description: Large radius · one step above default. 2026-08-16 Figma variable sync — present in the SCDS Primitives collection (radius/large), absent from code. Routed via semantic radius.surfaceLarge.

circle.$description: Pill / full circle. Status dots, brand stamp.

hairline.$description: 1px · default rule weight. Card borders, Divider, Input border, NavBar underline. Sprint 4 addition.

focus.$description: 2px · focus-ring outline weight. Stronger than hairline so focus state reads at distance. Sprint 4 addition.

accent.$description: 3px · accent rule. Alert left-rule, ProgressIndicator bar thickness. Sprint 4 addition.

1082.$description: 1082px · content measure. Brand-site main column cap; the sidebar sits outside it (Levi, 2026-10-08). Off the spacing ladders by design: a column width, not a gap. 2026-10-08 (WQ-100, brand-site-nav-layout).

orchestrated.$description: 720ms · page, route, choreographed reveal. Justify anything longer in writing.

out.$description: Quint-out · primary easing. Hover, state changes, most things that ease in or out.

outStrong.$description: Strong quint-out · press/release. From levibahn.com convention.

springOut.$description: Overshoot release · CSS approximation of the studio tap-scale spring (Drams press-spring, 2026-07-23). Interactive release phase only.

cinematic.$description: Long deliberate · orchestrated only. Page transitions.

pressButton.$description: Button press scale · 0.985. Subtle confirmation press (levibahn.com).

pressTap.$description: Tap target press scale · 0.92. Heavier touch affordance.

pressCard.$description: Card press scale · 0.995. A whole card is a large target, so it moves less than a button (studio-pm ADR-074 §29).

recedeBoard.$description: Board recede scale · 0.98. The surface behind a sheet steps back while the sheet is up (studio-pm ADR-074 §25).
Board recede opacity · 0.6. The surface behind a sheet dims toward the page ground while the sheet is up (studio-pm ADR-074 §25, ADR-080).
